title: Design a Document-Extraction Pipeline
summary: Turn a million invoices and contracts a month into validated structured records. The design is a batch pipeline: OCR or vision, schema-constrained output, field-level confidence, cross-field validation and a human-review queue sized by the maths of review rate and error cost.
objectives: Size a batch extraction system from documents per month: pages, tokens, cost, and throughput expressed as documents per second
Draw the pipeline and trace one document from upload to a validated record
Explain how schema-constrained decoding guarantees valid structure and what it does not guarantee
Combine field confidence, calibration and cross-field validators to decide what needs a human
Compute review rate, reviewer headcount, cost per document and the confidence threshold implied by error cost
prerequisites: Work through [A Framework for LLM System Design](/learn/llm-system-design/design-framework) first. It helps to know [few-shot examples and structured outputs](/learn/prompt-and-context/few-shot-and-structured) and [scoring against references](/learn/evaluation/reference-scoring).
